A000001.name: Number of groups of order n.
A000001.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000002.name: Kolakoski sequence: a(n) is length of n-th run; a(1) = 1; sequence consists just of 1's and 2's.
A000002.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000005.name: d(n) (also called tau(n) or sigma_0(n)), the number of divisors of n.
A000005.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000006.name: Integer part of square root of n-th prime.
A000006.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000008.name: Number of ways of making change for n cents using coins of 1, 2, 5, 10 cents.
A000008.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000009.name: Expansion of Product_{m >= 1} (1 + x^m); number of partitions of n into distinct parts; number of partitions of n into odd parts.
A000009.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000010.name: Euler totient function phi(n): count numbers <= n and prime to n.
A000010.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000012.name: The simplest sequence of positive numbers: the all 1's sequence.
A000012.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, May 16 1994

A000016.name: a(n) is the number of distinct (infinite) output sequences from binary n-stage shift register which feeds back the complement of the last stage.
A000016.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000026.name: Mosaic numbers or multiplicative projection of n: if n = Product (p_j^k_j) then a(n) = Product (p_j * k_j).
A000026.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000027.name: The positive integers. Also called the natural numbers, the whole numbers or the counting numbers, but these terms are ambiguous.
A000027.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000028.name: Let k = p_1^e_1 p_2^e_2 p_3^e_3 ... be the prime factorization of n. Sequence gives k such that the sum of the numbers of 1's in the binary expansions of e_1, e_2, e_3, ... is odd.
A000028.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Simon Plouffe_

A000029.name: Number of necklaces with n beads of 2 colors, allowing turning over (these are also called bracelets).
A000029.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000031.name: Number of n-bead necklaces with 2 colors when turning over is not allowed; also number of output sequences from a simple n-stage cycling shift register; also number of binary irreducible polynomials whose degree divides n.
A000031.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000032.name: Lucas numbers beginning at 2: L(n) = L(n-1) + L(n-2), L(0) = 2, L(1) = 1.
A000032.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, May 24 1994

A000035.name: Period 2: repeat [0, 1]; a(n) = n mod 2; parity of n.
A000035.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000037.name: Numbers that are not squares (or, the nonsquares).
A000037.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Simon Plouffe_

A000041.name: a(n) is the number of partitions of n (the partition numbers).
A000041.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000043.name: Mersenne exponents: primes p such that 2^p - 1 is prime. Then 2^p - 1 is called a Mersenne prime.
A000043.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000045.name: Fibonacci numbers: F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2) with F(0) = 0 and F(1) = 1.
A000045.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, 1964

A000055.name: Number of trees with n unlabeled nodes.
A000055.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000058.name: Sylvester's sequence: a(n+1) = a(n)^2 - a(n) + 1, with a(0) = 2.
A000058.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000069.name: Odious numbers: numbers with an odd number of 1's in their binary expansion.
A000069.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000073.name: Tribonacci numbers: a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-2) + a(n-3) for n >= 3 with a(0) = a(1) = 0 and a(2) = 1.
A000073.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000078.name: Tetranacci numbers: a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-2) + a(n-3) + a(n-4) for n >= 4 with a(0) = a(1) = a(2) = 0 and a(3) = 1.
A000078.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000081.name: Number of unlabeled rooted trees with n nodes (or connected functions with a fixed point).
A000081.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000085.name: Number of self-inverse permutations on n letters, also known as involutions; number of standard Young tableaux with n cells.
A000085.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_ and _J. H. Conway_

A000089.name: Number of solutions to x^2 + 1 == 0 (mod n).
A000089.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000095.name: Number of fixed points of Gamma_0 (n) of type i.
A000095.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000110.name: Bell or exponential numbers: number of ways to partition a set of n labeled elements.
A000110.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000111.name: Euler or up/down numbers: e.g.f. sec(x) + tan(x). Also for n >= 2, half the number of alternating permutations on n letters (A001250).
A000111.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000113.name: Number of transformation groups of order n.
A000113.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000118.name: Number of ways of writing n as a sum of 4 squares; also theta series of four-dimensional cubic lattice Z^4.
A000118.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000119.name: Number of representations of n as a sum of distinct Fibonacci numbers.
A000119.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000120.name: 1's-counting sequence: number of 1's in binary expansion of n (or the binary weight of n).
A000120.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000122.name: Expansion of Jacobi theta function theta_3(x) = Sum_{m =-oo..oo} x^(m^2) (number of integer solutions to k^2 = n).
A000122.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000123.name: Number of binary partitions: number of partitions of 2n into powers of 2.
A000123.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000124.name: Central polygonal numbers (the Lazy Caterer's sequence): n(n+1)/2 + 1; or, maximal number of pieces formed when slicing a pancake with n cuts.
A000124.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000125.name: Cake numbers: maximal number of pieces resulting from n planar cuts through a cube (or cake): C(n+1,3) + n + 1.
A000125.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000127.name: Maximal number of regions obtained by joining n points around a circle by straight lines. Also number of regions in 4-space formed by n-1 hyperplanes.
A000127.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000129.name: Pell numbers: a(0) = 0, a(1) = 1; for n > 1, a(n) = 2*a(n-1) + a(n-2).
A000129.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000142.name: Factorial numbers: n! = 1*2*3*4*...*n (order of symmetric group S_n, number of permutations of n letters).
A000142.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000161.name: Number of partitions of n into 2 squares.
A000161.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000164.name: Number of partitions of n into 3 squares (allowing part zero).
A000164.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000166.name: Subfactorial or rencontres numbers, or derangements: number of permutations of n elements with no fixed points.
A000166.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000172.name: The Franel number a(n) = Sum_{k = 0..n} binomial(n,k)^3.
A000172.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000178.name: Superfactorials: product of first n factorials.
A000178.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000179.name: Ménage numbers: a(0) = 1, a(1) = -1, and for n >= 2, a(n) = number of permutations s of [0, ..., n-1] such that s(i) != i and s(i) != i+1 (mod n) for all i.
A000179.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000182.name: Tangent (or "Zag") numbers: e.g.f. tan(x), also (up to signs) e.g.f. tanh(x).
A000182.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000188.name: (1) Number of solutions to x^2 == 0 (mod n). (2) Also square root of largest square dividing n. (3) Also max_{ d divides n } gcd(d, n/d).
A000188.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000194.name: n appears 2n times, for n >= 1; also nearest integer to square root of n.
A000194.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000196.name: Integer part of square root of n. Or, number of positive squares <= n. Or, n appears 2n+1 times.
A000196.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000201.name: Lower Wythoff sequence (a Beatty sequence): a(n) = floor(n*phi), where phi = (1+sqrt(5))/2 = A001622.
A000201.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000203.name: a(n) = sigma(n), the sum of the divisors of n. Also called sigma_1(n).
A000203.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000204.name: Lucas numbers (beginning with 1): L(n) = L(n-1) + L(n-2) with L(1) = 1, L(2) = 3.
A000204.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000213.name: Tribonacci numbers: a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-2) + a(n-3) with a(0)=a(1)=a(2)=1.
A000213.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000217.name: Triangular numbers: a(n) = binomial(n+1,2) = n*(n+1)/2 = 0 + 1 + 2 + ... + n.
A000217.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000219.name: Number of plane partitions (or planar partitions) of n.
A000219.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000225.name: a(n) = 2^n - 1. (Sometimes called Mersenne numbers, although that name is usually reserved for A001348.)
A000225.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000262.name: Number of "sets of lists": number of partitions of {1,...,n} into any number of lists, where a list means an ordered subset.
A000262.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000265.name: Remove all factors of 2 from n; or largest odd divisor of n; or odd part of n.
A000265.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000267.name: Integer part of square root of 4n+1.
A000267.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000272.name: Number of trees on n labeled nodes: n^(n-2) with a(0)=1.
A000272.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000292.name: Tetrahedral (or triangular pyramidal) numbers: a(n) = C(n+2,3) = n*(n+1)*(n+2)/6.
A000292.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000295.name: Eulerian numbers (Euler's triangle: column k=2 of A008292, column k=1 of A173018).
A000295.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000301.name: a(n) = a(n-1)*a(n-2) with a(0) = 1, a(1) = 2; also a(n) = 2^Fibonacci(n).
A000301.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, Mar 15 1996

A000312.name: a(n) = n^n; number of labeled mappings from n points to themselves (endofunctions).
A000312.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000328.name: Number of points of norm <= n^2 in square lattice.
A000328.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000330.name: Square pyramidal numbers: a(n) = 0^2 + 1^2 + 2^2 + ... + n^2 = n*(n+1)*(2*n+1)/6.
A000330.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000353.name: Primes p == 7, 19, 23 (mod 40) such that (p-1)/2 is also prime.
A000353.author: _Robert A. J. Matthews_

A000358.name: Number of binary necklaces of length n with no subsequence 00, excluding the necklace "0".
A000358.author: _Frank Ruskey_

A000360.name: Distribution of nonempty triangles inside a fractal rep-4-tile.
A000360.author: _M. Jeremie Lafitte (Levitas)_

A000364.name: Euler (or secant or "Zig") numbers: e.g.f. (even powers only) sec(x) = 1/cos(x).
A000364.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000377.name: Expansion of f(-q^3) * f(-q^8) * chi(-q^12) / chi(-q) in powers of q where chi(), f() are Ramanujan theta functions.
A000377.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000379.name: Numbers where total number of 1-bits in the exponents of their prime factorization is even; a 2-way classification of integers: complement of A000028.
A000379.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000392.name: Stirling numbers of second kind S(n,3).
A000392.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000396.name: Perfect numbers k: k is equal to the sum of the proper divisors of k.
A000396.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000422.name: Concatenation of numbers from n down to 1.
A000422.author: R. Muller

A000435.name: Normalized total height of all nodes in all rooted trees with n labeled nodes.
A000435.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000453.name: Stirling numbers of the second kind, S(n,4).
A000453.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000522.name: Total number of ordered k-tuples (k=0..n) of distinct elements from an n-element set: a(n) = Sum_{k=0..n} n!/k!.
A000522.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000537.name: Sum of first n cubes; or n-th triangular number squared.
A000537.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000567.name: Octagonal numbers: n*(3*n-2). Also called star numbers.
A000567.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000579.name: Figurate numbers or binomial coefficients C(n,6).
A000579.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000587.name: Rao Uppuluri-Carpenter numbers (or complementary Bell numbers): e.g.f. = exp(1 - exp(x)).
A000587.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000594.name: Ramanujan's tau function (or Ramanujan numbers, or tau numbers).
A000594.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000629.name: Number of necklaces of partitions of n+1 labeled beads.
A000629.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Don Knuth_, Nick Singer (nsinger(AT)eos.hitc.com)

A000670.name: Fubini numbers: number of preferential arrangements of n labeled elements; or number of weak orders on n labeled elements; or number of ordered partitions of [n].
A000670.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000688.name: Number of Abelian groups of order n; number of factorizations of n into prime powers.
A000688.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000695.name: Moser-de Bruijn sequence: sums of distinct powers of 4.
A000695.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000700.name: Expansion of Product_{k>=0} (1 + x^(2k+1)); number of partitions of n into distinct odd parts; number of self-conjugate partitions; number of symmetric Ferrers graphs with n nodes.
A000700.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000720.name: pi(n), the number of primes <= n. Sometimes called PrimePi(n) to distinguish it from the number 3.14159...
A000720.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000740.name: Number of 2n-bead balanced binary necklaces of fundamental period 2n, equivalent to reversed complement; also Dirichlet convolution of b_n=2^(n-1) with mu(n); also number of components of Mandelbrot set corresponding to Julia sets with an attractive n-cycle.
A000740.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000744.name: Boustrophedon transform (second version) of Fibonacci numbers 1,1,2,3,...
A000744.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000788.name: Total number of 1's in binary expansions of 0, ..., n.
A000788.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000796.name: Decimal expansion of Pi (or digits of Pi).
A000796.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000914.name: Stirling numbers of the first kind: s(n+2, n).
A000914.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000925.name: Number of ordered ways of writing n as a sum of 2 squares of nonnegative integers.
A000925.author: Jacques Haubrich (jhaubrich(AT)freeler.nl)

A000928.name: Irregular primes: primes p such that at least one of the numerators of the Bernoulli numbers B_2, B_4, ..., B_{p-3} (A000367) is divisible by p.
A000928.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000930.name: Narayana's cows sequence: a(0) = a(1) = a(2) = 1; thereafter a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-3).
A000930.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000931.name: Padovan sequence (or Padovan numbers): a(n) = a(n-2) + a(n-3) with a(0) = 1, a(1) = a(2) = 0.
A000931.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000945.name: Euclid-Mullin sequence: a(1) = 2, a(n+1) is smallest prime factor of 1 + Product_{k=1..n} a(k).
A000945.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000957.name: Fine's sequence (or Fine numbers): number of relations of valence >= 1 on an n-set; also number of ordered rooted trees with n nodes having root of even degree.
A000957.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000960.name: Flavius Josephus's sieve: Start with the natural numbers; at the k-th sieving step, remove every (k+1)-st term of the sequence remaining after the (k-1)-st sieving step; iterate.
A000960.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000961.name: Powers of primes. Alternatively, 1 and the prime powers (p^k, p prime, k >= 1).
A000961.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A000975.name: a(2n) = 2*a(2n-1), a(2n+1) = 2*a(2n)+1 (also a(n) is the n-th number without consecutive equal binary digits).
A000975.author: _Mira Bernstein_, _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Robert G. Wilson v_, Sep 13 1996

A000978.name: Wagstaff numbers: numbers k such that (2^k + 1)/3 is prime.
A000978.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Robert G. Wilson v_

A001003.name: Schroeder's second problem (generalized parentheses); also called super-Catalan numbers or little Schroeder numbers.
A001003.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001006.name: Motzkin numbers: number of ways of drawing any number of nonintersecting chords joining n (labeled) points on a circle.
A001006.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001008.name: a(n) = numerator of harmonic number H(n) = Sum_{i=1..n} 1/i.
A001008.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001037.name: Number of degree-n irreducible polynomials over GF(2); number of n-bead necklaces with beads of 2 colors when turning over is not allowed and with primitive period n; number of binary Lyndon words of length n.
A001037.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001044.name: a(n) = (n!)^2.
A001044.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_ and _R. K. Guy_

A001045.name: Jacobsthal sequence (or Jacobsthal numbers): a(n) = a(n-1) + 2*a(n-2), with a(0) = 0, a(1) = 1; also a(n) = nearest integer to 2^n/3.
A001045.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001055.name: The multiplicative partition function: number of ways of factoring n with all factors greater than 1 (a(1) = 1 by convention).
A001055.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001057.name: Canonical enumeration of integers: interleaved positive and negative integers with zero prepended.
A001057.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001060.name: a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-2) with a(0)=2, a(1)=5. Sometimes called the Evangelist Sequence.
A001060.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001065.name: Sum of proper divisors (or aliquot parts) of n: sum of divisors of n that are less than n.
A001065.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _R. K. Guy_

A001067.name: Numerator of Bernoulli(2*n)/(2*n).
A001067.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, Richard E. Borcherds (reb(AT)math.berkeley.edu)

A001076.name: Denominators of continued fraction convergents to sqrt(5).
A001076.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001106.name: 9-gonal (or enneagonal or nonagonal) numbers: a(n) = n*(7*n-5)/2.
A001106.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001108.name: a(n)-th triangular number is a square: a(n+1) = 6*a(n) - a(n-1) + 2, with a(0) = 0, a(1) = 1.
A001108.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001147.name: Double factorial of odd numbers: a(n) = (2*n-1)!! = 1*3*5*...*(2*n-1).
A001147.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001156.name: Number of partitions of n into squares.
A001156.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001158.name: sigma_3(n): sum of cubes of divisors of n.
A001158.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _R. K. Guy_

A001175.name: Pisano periods (or Pisano numbers): period of Fibonacci numbers mod n.
A001175.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001177.name: Fibonacci entry points: a(n) = least k >= 1 such that n divides Fibonacci number F_k (=A000045(k)).
A001177.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001190.name: Wedderburn-Etherington numbers: unlabeled binary rooted trees (every node has outdegree 0 or 2) with n endpoints (and 2n-1 nodes in all).
A001190.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001203.name: Simple continued fraction expansion of Pi.
A001203.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001221.name: Number of distinct primes dividing n (also called omega(n)).
A001221.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001222.name: Number of prime divisors of n counted with multiplicity (also called big omega of n, bigomega(n) or Omega(n)).
A001222.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001223.name: Prime gaps: differences between consecutive primes.
A001223.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001227.name: Number of odd divisors of n.
A001227.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001263.name: Triangle of Narayana numbers T(n,k) = C(n-1,k-1)*C(n,k-1)/k with 1 <= k <= n, read by rows. Also called the Catalan triangle.
A001263.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001285.name: Thue-Morse sequence: let A_k denote the first 2^k terms; then A_0 = 1 and for k >= 0, A_{k+1} = A_k B_k, where B_k is obtained from A_k by interchanging 1's and 2's.
A001285.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001296.name: 4-dimensional pyramidal numbers: a(n) = (3*n+1)*binomial(n+2, 3)/4. Also Stirling2(n+2, n).
A001296.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001299.name: Number of ways of making change for n cents using coins of 1, 5, 10, 25 cents.
A001299.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, Mar 15 1996

A001316.name: Gould's sequence: a(n) = Sum_{k=0..n} (binomial(n,k) mod 2); number of odd entries in row n of Pascal's triangle (A007318); a(n) = 2^A000120(n).
A001316.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001317.name: Sierpiński's triangle (Pascal's triangle mod 2) converted to decimal.
A001317.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001333.name: Pell-Lucas numbers: numerators of continued fraction convergents to sqrt(2).
A001333.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_ and _R. K. Guy_

A001348.name: Mersenne numbers: 2^p - 1, where p is prime.
A001348.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001358.name: Semiprimes (or biprimes): products of two primes.
A001358.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _R. K. Guy_

A001399.name: a(n) is the number of partitions of n into at most 3 parts; also partitions of n+3 in which the greatest part is 3; also number of unlabeled multigraphs with 3 nodes and n edges.
A001399.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001414.name: Integer log of n: sum of primes dividing n (with repetition). Also called sopfr(n).
A001414.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001462.name: Golomb's sequence: a(n) is the number of times n occurs, starting with a(1) = 1.
A001462.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001463.name: Partial sums of A001462; also a(n) is the last occurrence of n in A001462.
A001463.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001469.name: Genocchi numbers (of first kind); unsigned coefficients give expansion of x*tan(x/2).
A001469.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001476.name: Numbers that are not the sum of distinct positive cubes.
A001476.author: Jeff Adams (jeff.adams(AT)byu.net)

A001481.name: Numbers that are the sum of 2 squares.
A001481.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001511.name: The ruler function: exponent of the highest power of 2 dividing 2n. Equivalently, the 2-adic valuation of 2n.
A001511.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001567.name: Fermat pseudoprimes to base 2, also called Sarrus numbers or Poulet numbers.
A001567.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001590.name: Tribonacci numbers: a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-2) + a(n-3) with a(0)=0, a(1)=1, a(2)=0.
A001590.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001597.name: Perfect powers: m^k where m > 0 and k >= 2.
A001597.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001599.name: Harmonic or Ore numbers: numbers k such that the harmonic mean of the divisors of k is an integer.
A001599.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001600.name: Harmonic means of divisors of harmonic numbers.
A001600.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001608.name: Perrin sequence (or Perrin numbers, or Ondrej Such sequence): a(n) = a(n-2) + a(n-3) with a(0) = 3, a(1) = 0, a(2) = 2.
A001608.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001615.name: Dedekind psi function: n * Product_{p|n, p prime} (1 + 1/p).
A001615.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001620.name: Decimal expansion of Euler's constant (or the Euler-Mascheroni constant), gamma.
A001620.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001622.name: Decimal expansion of golden ratio phi (or tau) = (1 + sqrt(5))/2.
A001622.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001653.name: Numbers k such that 2*k^2 - 1 is a square.
A001653.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001687.name: a(n) = a(n-2) + a(n-5).
A001687.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, following a suggestion from _Robert G. Wilson v_

A001694.name: Powerful numbers, definition (1): if a prime p divides n then p^2 must also divide n (also called squareful, square full, square-full or 2-powerful numbers).
A001694.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001710.name: Order of alternating group A_n, or number of even permutations of n letters.
A001710.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001764.name: a(n) = binomial(3*n,n)/(2*n+1) (enumerates ternary trees and also noncrossing trees).
A001764.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001783.name: n-phi-torial, or phi-torial of n: Product k, 1 <= k <= n, k relatively prime to n.
A001783.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001840.name: Expansion of g.f. x/((1 - x)^2*(1 - x^3)).
A001840.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001844.name: Centered square numbers: a(n) = 2*n*(n+1)+1. Sums of two consecutive squares. Also, consider all Pythagorean triples (X, Y, Z=Y+1) ordered by increasing Z; then sequence gives Z values.
A001844.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001845.name: Centered octahedral numbers (crystal ball sequence for cubic lattice).
A001845.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001850.name: Central Delannoy numbers: a(n) = Sum_{k=0..n} C(n,k)*C(n+k,k).
A001850.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001855.name: Sorting numbers: maximal number of comparisons for sorting n elements by binary insertion.
A001855.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001857.name: a(1)=2, a(2)=3; for n >= 3, a(n) is smallest number that is uniquely of the form a(j) + a(k) with 1 <= j < k < n.
A001857.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001906.name: F(2n) = bisection of Fibonacci sequence: a(n) = 3*a(n-1) - a(n-2).
A001906.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001913.name: Full reptend primes: primes with primitive root 10.
A001913.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001918.name: Least positive primitive root of n-th prime.
A001918.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001950.name: Upper Wythoff sequence (a Beatty sequence): a(n) = floor(n*phi^2), where phi = (1+sqrt(5))/2.
A001950.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001952.name: A Beatty sequence: a(n) = floor(n*(2 + sqrt(2))).
A001952.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001969.name: Evil numbers: nonnegative integers with an even number of 1's in their binary expansion.
A001969.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A001970.name: Functional determinants; partitions of partitions; Euler transform applied twice to all 1's sequence.
A001970.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002024.name: k appears k times; a(n) = floor(sqrt(2n) + 1/2).
A002024.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002033.name: Number of perfect partitions of n.
A002033.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002034.name: Kempner numbers: smallest positive integer m such that n divides m!.
A002034.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002053.name: a(n) = least value of m for which Liouville's function A002819(m) = -n.
A002053.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002057.name: Fourth convolution of Catalan numbers: a(n) = 4*binomial(2*n+3,n)/(n+4).
A002057.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002061.name: Central polygonal numbers: a(n) = n^2 - n + 1.
A002061.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002083.name: Narayana-Zidek-Capell numbers: a(n) = 1 for n <= 2. Otherwise a(2n) = 2a(2n-1), a(2n+1) = 2a(2n) - a(n).
A002083.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002088.name: Sum of totient function: a(n) = Sum_{k=1..n} phi(k), cf. A000010.
A002088.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002093.name: Highly abundant numbers: numbers k such that sigma(k) > sigma(m) for all m < k.
A002093.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002110.name: Primorial numbers (first definition): product of first n primes. Sometimes written prime(n)#.
A002110.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_ and _J. H. Conway_

A002117.name: Apéry's number or Apéry's constant zeta(3). Decimal expansion of zeta(3) = Sum_{m >= 1} 1/m^3.
A002117.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002129.name: Generalized sum of divisors function: excess of sum of odd divisors of n over sum of even divisors of n.
A002129.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002144.name: Pythagorean primes: primes of the form 4*k + 1.
A002144.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002162.name: Decimal expansion of the natural logarithm of 2.
A002162.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002182.name: Highly composite numbers: numbers n where d(n), the number of divisors of n (A000005), increases to a record.
A002182.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002183.name: Number of divisors of n-th highly composite number.
A002183.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002188.name: Sprague-Grundy value for Grundy's game when starting with n tokens.
A002188.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002193.name: Decimal expansion of square root of 2.
A002193.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002201.name: Superior highly composite numbers: positive integers n for which there is an e > 0 such that d(n)/n^e >= d(k)/k^e for all k > 1, where the function d(n) counts the divisors of n (A000005).
A002201.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002203.name: Companion Pell numbers: a(n) = 2*a(n-1) + a(n-2), a(0) = a(1) = 2.
A002203.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002212.name: Number of restricted hexagonal polyominoes with n cells.
A002212.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, Ronald C. Read

A002217.name: Starting with n, repeatedly calculate the sum of prime factors (with repetition) of the previous term, until reaching 0 or a fixed point: a(n) is the number of terms in the resulting sequence.
A002217.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002233.name: a(1) = 1; for n > 1, a(n) = least positive prime primitive root of n-th prime.
A002233.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002251.name: Start with the nonnegative integers; then swap L(k) and U(k) for all k >= 1, where L = A000201, U = A001950 (lower and upper Wythoff sequences).
A002251.author: _Michael Kleber_

A002260.name: Triangle read by rows: T(n,k) = k for n >= 1, k = 1..n.
A002260.author: Angele Hamel (amh(AT)maths.soton.ac.uk)

A002262.name: Triangle read by rows: T(n,k) = k, 0 <= k <= n, in which row n lists the first n+1 nonnegative integers.
A002262.author: Angele Hamel (amh(AT)maths.soton.ac.uk)

A002267.name: The 15 supersingular primes: primes dividing order of Monster simple group.
A002267.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002293.name: Number of dissections of a polygon: binomial(4*n, n)/(3*n + 1).
A002293.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002313.name: Primes congruent to 1 or 2 modulo 4; or, primes of form x^2 + y^2; or, -1 is a square mod p.
A002313.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002314.name: Minimal integer square root of -1 modulo p, where p is the n-th prime of the form 4k+1.
A002314.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002321.name: Mertens's function: Sum_{k=1..n} mu(k), where mu is the Moebius function A008683.
A002321.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002322.name: Reduced totient function psi(n): least k such that x^k == 1 (mod n) for all x prime to n; also known as the Carmichael lambda function (exponent of unit group mod n); also called the universal exponent of n.
A002322.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002329.name: Periods of reciprocals of integers prime to 10.
A002329.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002371.name: Period of decimal expansion of 1/(n-th prime) (0 by convention for the primes 2 and 5).
A002371.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002374.name: Largest prime <= n in any decomposition of 2n into a sum of two odd primes.
A002374.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002375.name: From Goldbach conjecture: number of decompositions of 2n into an unordered sum of two odd primes.
A002375.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002378.name: Oblong (or promic, pronic, or heteromecic) numbers: a(n) = n*(n+1).
A002378.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002385.name: Palindromic primes: prime numbers whose decimal expansion is a palindrome.
A002385.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Simon Plouffe_

A002412.name: Hexagonal pyramidal numbers, or greengrocer's numbers.
A002412.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002420.name: Expansion of sqrt(1 - 4*x) in powers of x.
A002420.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, Dec 11 1996

A002426.name: Central trinomial coefficients: largest coefficient of (1 + x + x^2)^n.
A002426.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Simon Plouffe_

A002448.name: Expansion of Jacobi theta function theta_4(x).
A002448.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002473.name: 7-smooth numbers: positive numbers whose prime divisors are all <= 7.
A002473.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002486.name: Apart from two leading terms (which are present by convention), denominators of convergents to Pi (A002485 and A046947 give numerators).
A002486.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002487.name: Stern's diatomic series (or Stern-Brocot sequence): a(0) = 0, a(1) = 1; for n > 0: a(2*n) = a(n), a(2*n+1) = a(n) + a(n+1).
A002487.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002491.name: Smallest number of stones in Tchoukaillon (or Mancala, or Kalahari) solitaire that make use of n-th hole.
A002491.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002524.name: Number of permutations of length n within distance 2 of a fixed permutation.
A002524.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002559.name: Markoff (or Markov) numbers: union of positive integers x, y, z satisfying x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 3*x*y*z.
A002559.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_ and _J. H. Conway_

A002620.name: Quarter-squares: a(n) = floor(n/2)*ceiling(n/2). Equivalently, a(n) = floor(n^2/4).
A002620.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002654.name: Number of ways of writing n as a sum of at most two nonzero squares, where order matters; also (number of divisors of n of form 4m+1) - (number of divisors of form 4m+3).
A002654.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002657.name: Numerators of Cauchy numbers of second type (= Bernoulli numbers B_n^{(n)}).
A002657.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002790.name: Denominators of Cauchy numbers of second type (= Bernoulli numbers B_n^{(n)}).
A002790.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002796.name: Numbers that are divisible by each nonzero digit.
A002796.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002805.name: a(n) = denominator of harmonic number H(n) = Sum_{i=1..n} 1/i.
A002805.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002808.name: The composite numbers: numbers n of the form x*y for x > 1 and y > 1.
A002808.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002815.name: a(n) = n + Sum_{k=1..n} pi(k), where pi() = A000720.
A002815.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Robert G. Wilson v_, _Mira Bernstein_

A002819.name: Liouville's function L(n) = partial sums of A008836.
A002819.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002822.name: Numbers m such that 6m-1, 6m+1 are twin primes.
A002822.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002852.name: Continued fraction for Euler's constant (or Euler-Mascheroni constant) gamma.
A002852.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002858.name: Ulam numbers: a(1) = 1; a(2) = 2; for n>2, a(n) = least number > a(n-1) which is a unique sum of two distinct earlier terms.
A002858.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002859.name: a(1) = 1, a(2) = 3; for n >= 3, a(n) is smallest number that is uniquely of the form a(j) + a(k) with 1 <= j < k < n.
A002859.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Mira Bernstein_

A002895.name: Domb numbers: number of 2n-step polygons on diamond lattice.
A002895.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002965.name: Interleave denominators (A000129) and numerators (A001333) of convergents to sqrt(2).
A002965.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A002997.name: Carmichael numbers: composite numbers k such that a^(k-1) == 1 (mod k) for every a coprime to k.
A002997.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003001.name: Smallest number of multiplicative persistence n.
A003001.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003022.name: Length of shortest (or optimal) Golomb ruler with n marks.
A003022.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003044.name: For n > 4, a(n) is the least integer > a(n-1) with precisely two representations a(n) = a(i) + a(j), 1 <= i < j < n; and a(n) = n for n=1..4.
A003044.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003056.name: n appears n+1 times. Also the array A(n,k) = n+k (n >= 0, k >= 0) read by antidiagonals. Also inverse of triangular numbers.
A003056.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003059.name: k appears 2k-1 times. Also, square root of n, rounded up.
A003059.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003106.name: Number of partitions of n into parts 5k+2 or 5k+3.
A003106.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Herman P. Robinson_

A003108.name: Number of partitions of n into cubes.
A003108.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Herman P. Robinson_

A003132.name: Sum of squares of digits of n.
A003132.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003137.name: Write n in base 3 and juxtapose.
A003137.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003159.name: Numbers whose binary representation ends in an even number of zeros.
A003159.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Simon Plouffe_

A003188.name: Decimal equivalent of Gray code for n.
A003188.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003215.name: Hex (or centered hexagonal) numbers: 3*n*(n+1)+1 (crystal ball sequence for hexagonal lattice).
A003215.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003263.name: Number of representations of n as a sum of distinct Lucas numbers 1, 3, 4, 7, 11, ... (A000204).
A003263.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003266.name: Product of first n nonzero Fibonacci numbers F(1), ..., F(n).
A003266.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003278.name: Szekeres's sequence: a(n)-1 in ternary = n-1 in binary; also: a(1) = 1, a(2) = 2, and thereafter a(n) is smallest number k which avoids any 3-term arithmetic progression in a(1), a(2), ..., a(n-1), k.
A003278.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_ and _Richard Stanley_

A003309.name: Ludic numbers: apply the same sieve as Eratosthenes, but cross off every k-th remaining number.
A003309.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003319.name: Number of connected permutations of [1..n] (those not fixing [1..j] for 0 < j < n). Also called indecomposable permutations, or irreducible permutations.
A003319.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003401.name: Numbers of edges of regular polygons constructible with ruler (or, more precisely, an unmarked straightedge) and compass.
A003401.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _R. K. Guy_

A003415.name: a(n) = n' = arithmetic derivative of n: a(0) = a(1) = 0, a(prime) = 1, a(m*n) = m*a(n) + n*a(m).
A003415.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _R. K. Guy_

A003418.name: Least common multiple (or LCM) of {1, 2, ..., n} for n >= 1, a(0) = 1.
A003418.author: Roland Anderson (roland.anderson(AT)swipnet.se)

A003434.name: Number of iterations of phi(x) at n needed to reach 1.
A003434.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003458.name: Erdős-Selfridge function: a(n) is the least number m > n+1 such that the least prime factor of binomial(m, n) is > n.
A003458.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Simon Plouffe_

A003465.name: Number of ways to cover an n-set.
A003465.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003504.name: a(0)=a(1)=1; thereafter a(n+1) = (1/n)*Sum_{k=0..n} a(k)^2 (a(n) is not always integral!).
A003504.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _R. K. Guy_

A003506.name: Triangle of denominators in Leibniz's Harmonic Triangle a(n,k), n >= 1, 1 <= k <= n.
A003506.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003586.name: 3-smooth numbers: numbers of the form 2^i*3^j with i, j >= 0.
A003586.author: _Paul Zimmermann_, Dec 11 1996

A003592.name: Numbers of the form 2^i*5^j with i, j >= 0.
A003592.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003601.name: Numbers j such that the average of the divisors of j is an integer: sigma_0(j) divides sigma_1(j). Alternatively, numbers j such that tau(j) (A000005(j)) divides sigma(j) (A000203(j)).
A003601.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Mira Bernstein_

A003602.name: Kimberling's paraphrase of the binary number system: if n = (2k-1)*2^m then a(n) = k.
A003602.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Mira Bernstein_

A003603.name: Fractal sequence obtained from Fibonacci numbers (or Wythoff array).
A003603.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Mira Bernstein_

A003622.name: The Wythoff compound sequence AA: a(n) = floor(n*phi^2) - 1, where phi = (1+sqrt(5))/2.
A003622.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Mira Bernstein_, _Marc LeBrun_

A003657.name: Discriminants of imaginary quadratic fields, negated.
A003657.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Mira Bernstein_

A003658.name: Fundamental discriminants of real quadratic fields; indices of primitive positive Dirichlet L-series.
A003658.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Mira Bernstein_, _Eric W. Weisstein_

A003666.name: a(n) is smallest number which is uniquely of the form a(j) + a(k) with 1 <= j < k < n and a(1) = 1, a(2) = 4.
A003666.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Mira Bernstein_

A003667.name: a(n) is smallest number which is uniquely of the form a(j) + a(k) with 1 <= j < k < n and a(1) = 1, a(2) = 5.
A003667.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Mira Bernstein_

A003676.name: Decimal expansion of the Planck constant h (Joule * second).
A003676.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Mira Bernstein_

A003678.name: Decimal expansion of the SI unit c (speed of light in vacuum), c = 299792458 meters/second.
A003678.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003714.name: Fibbinary numbers: if n = F(i1) + F(i2) + ... + F(ik) is the Zeckendorf representation of n (i.e., write n in Fibonacci number system) then a(n) = 2^(i1 - 2) + 2^(i2 - 2) + ... + 2^(ik - 2). Also numbers whose binary representation contains no two adjacent 1's.
A003714.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003754.name: Numbers with no adjacent 0's in binary expansion.
A003754.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003849.name: The infinite Fibonacci word (start with 0, apply 0->01, 1->0, take limit).
A003849.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003870.name: Degrees of irreducible representations of symmetric group S_6.
A003870.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A003963.name: Fully multiplicative with a(p) = k if p is the k-th prime.
A003963.author: _Marc LeBrun_

A003972.name: Moebius transform of A003961; a(n) = phi(A003961(n)), where A003961 shifts the prime factorization of n one step towards the larger primes.
A003972.author: _Marc LeBrun_

A003983.name: Array read by antidiagonals with T(n,k) = min(n,k).
A003983.author: _Marc LeBrun_

A003986.name: Table T(n,k) = n OR k read by antidiagonals.
A003986.author: _Marc LeBrun_

A003987.name: Table of n XOR m (or Nim-sum of n and m) read by antidiagonals with m>=0, n>=0.
A003987.author: _Marc LeBrun_

A003988.name: Triangle with subscripts (1,1),(2,1),(1,2),(3,1),(2,2),(1,3), etc. in which entry (i,j) is [ i/j ].
A003988.author: _Marc LeBrun_

A003989.name: Triangle T from the array A(x, y) = gcd(x,y), for x >= 1, y >= 1, read by antidiagonals.
A003989.author: _Marc LeBrun_

A003991.name: Multiplication table read by antidiagonals: T(i,j) = i*j, i>=1, j>=1.
A003991.author: _Marc LeBrun_

A004001.name: Hofstadter-Conway $10000 sequence: a(n) = a(a(n-1)) + a(n-a(n-1)) with a(1) = a(2) = 1.
A004001.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A004016.name: Theta series of planar hexagonal lattice A_2.
A004016.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A004018.name: Theta series of square lattice (or number of ways of writing n as a sum of 2 squares). Often denoted by r(n) or r_2(n).
A004018.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A004086.name: Read n backwards (referred to as R(n) in many sequences).
A004086.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A004090.name: Sum of digits of Fibonacci numbers.
A004090.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A004149.name: Generalized Catalan numbers: a(n+1) = a(n) + Sum_{k=2..n-1} a(k)*a(n-1-k).
A004149.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A004154.name: a(n) = n! with trailing zeros omitted.
A004154.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A004211.name: Shifts one place left under 2nd-order binomial transform.
A004211.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A004212.name: Shifts one place left under 3rd-order binomial transform.
A004212.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A004247.name: Multiplication table read by antidiagonals: T(i,j) = i*j (i>=0, j>=0). Alternatively, multiplication triangle read by rows: P(i,j) = j*(i-j) (i>=0, 0<=j<=i).
A004247.author: _David W. Wilson_

A004248.name: Array read by ascending antidiagonals: A(n, k) = k^n.
A004248.author: _David W. Wilson_

A004394.author: _Matthew Conroy_

A004396.name: One even number followed by two odd numbers.
A004396.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A004490.name: Colossally abundant numbers: m for which there is a positive exponent epsilon such that sigma(m)/m^{1 + epsilon} >= sigma(k)/k^{1 + epsilon} for all k > 1, so that m attains the maximum value of sigma(m)/m^{1 + epsilon}.

A004613.name: Numbers that are divisible only by primes congruent to 1 mod 4.
A004613.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A004709.name: Cubefree numbers: numbers that are not divisible by any cube > 1.
A004709.author: _Steven Finch_, Jun 14 1998

A004718.name: The Danish composer Per Nørgård's "infinity sequence", invented in an attempt to unify in a perfect way repetition and variation: a(2n) = -a(n), a(2n+1) = a(n) + 1, a(0) = 0.
A004718.author: Jorn B. Olsson (olsson(AT)math.ku.dk)

A004736.name: Triangle read by rows: row n lists the first n positive integers in decreasing order.
A004736.author: R. Muller

A004772.name: Numbers that are not congruent to 1 (mod 4).
A004772.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A004957.name: a(n) = ceiling(n*phi^2), where phi is the golden ratio, A001622.
A004957.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005041.name: Positive integers k repeated ceiling(k/3) + 1 times.
A005041.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Jeffrey Shallit_

A005098.name: Numbers k such that 4k + 1 is prime.
A005098.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005100.name: Deficient numbers: numbers k such that sigma(k) < 2k.
A005100.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005101.name: Abundant numbers (sum of divisors of m exceeds 2m).
A005101.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005109.name: Class 1- (or Pierpont) primes: primes of the form 2^t*3^u + 1.
A005109.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Simon Plouffe_

A005114.name: Untouchable numbers, also called nonaliquot numbers: impossible values for the sum of aliquot parts function (A001065).
A005114.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005117.name: Squarefree numbers: numbers that are not divisible by a square greater than 1.
A005117.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005130.name: Robbins numbers: a(n) = Product_{k=0..n-1} (3k+1)!/(n+k)!; also the number of descending plane partitions whose parts do not exceed n; also the number of n X n alternating sign matrices (ASM's).
A005130.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005132.name: Recamán's sequence (or Recaman's sequence): a(0) = 0; for n > 0, a(n) = a(n-1) - n if nonnegative and not already in the sequence, otherwise a(n) = a(n-1) + n.

A005150.name: Look and Say sequence: describe the previous term! (method A - initial term is 1).
A005150.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005153.name: Practical numbers: positive integers m such that every k <= sigma(m) is a sum of distinct divisors of m. Also called panarithmic numbers.
A005153.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005171.name: Characteristic function of nonprimes: 0 if n is prime, else 1.
A005171.author: _Russ Cox_

A005179.name: Smallest number with exactly n divisors.
A005179.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, David Singmaster

A005185.name: Hofstadter Q-sequence: a(1) = a(2) = 1; a(n) = a(n-a(n-1)) + a(n-a(n-2)) for n > 2.
A005185.author: _Simon Plouffe_ and _N. J. A. Sloane_, May 20 1991

A005187.name: a(n) = a(floor(n/2)) + n; also denominators in expansion of 1/sqrt(1-x) are 2^a(n); also 2n - number of 1's in binary expansion of 2n.
A005187.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, May 20 1991; _Allan Wilks_, Dec 11 1999

A005188.name: Armstrong (or pluperfect, or Plus Perfect, or narcissistic) numbers: m-digit nonnegative  numbers equal to sum of the m-th powers of their digits.

A005203.name: Fibonacci numbers (or rabbit sequence) converted to decimal.
A005203.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005206.name: Hofstadter G-sequence: a(0) = 0; a(n) = n - a(a(n-1)) for n > 0.

A005235.name: Fortunate numbers: least m > 1 such that m + prime(n)# is prime, where p# denotes the product of all primes <= p.

A005236.name: Barriers for omega(n): numbers n such that, for all m < n, m + omega(m) <= n.
A005236.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005238.name: Numbers k such that k, k+1 and k+2 have the same number of divisors.
A005238.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005248.name: Bisection of Lucas numbers: a(n) = L(2*n) = A000032(2*n).
A005248.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005251.name: a(0) = 0, a(1) = a(2) = a(3) = 1; thereafter, a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-2) + a(n-4).
A005251.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_ and _R. K. Guy_

A005258.name: Apéry numbers: a(n) = Sum_{k=0..n} binomial(n,k)^2 * binomial(n+k,k).
A005258.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005341.name: Length of n-th term in Look and Say sequences A005150 and A007651.
A005341.author: _Jeffrey Shallit_

A005349.name: Niven (or Harshad, or harshad) numbers: numbers that are divisible by the sum of their digits.
A005349.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Robert G. Wilson v_

A005351.name: Base -2 representation for n regarded as base 2, then evaluated.
A005351.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005361.name: Product of exponents of prime factorization of n.
A005361.author: _Jeffrey Shallit_ and _Olivier Gérard_

A005384.name: Sophie Germain primes p: 2p+1 is also prime.
A005384.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005385.name: Safe primes p: (p-1)/2 is also prime.
A005385.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005448.name: Centered triangular numbers: a(n) = 3*n*(n-1)/2 + 1.
A005448.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _R. K. Guy_, Dec 12 1974

A005487.name: Starts 0, 4 and contains no 3-term arithmetic progression.
A005487.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005528.name: Størmer numbers or arc-cotangent irreducible numbers: numbers k such that the largest prime factor of k^2 + 1 is >= 2*k.

A005536.name: a(0) = 0; thereafter a(2n) = n - a(n) - a(n-1), a(2n+1) = n - 2a(n) + 1.

A005596.name: Decimal expansion of Artin's constant Product_{p=prime} (1-1/(p^2-p)).

A005663.name: Numerators of convergents to log_2(3) = log(3)/log(2).
A005663.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005700.name: a(n) = C(n)*C(n+2) - C(n+1)^2 where C() are the Catalan numbers A000108.
A005700.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005701.name: Number of exterior points formed by extending diagonals of n-gon in general position.
A005701.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Robert G. Wilson v_

A005728.name: Number of fractions in Farey series of order n.
A005728.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005811.name: Number of runs in binary expansion of n (n>0); number of 1's in Gray code for n.
A005811.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Jeffrey Shallit_, _Simon Plouffe_

A005823.name: Numbers whose ternary expansion contains no 1's.
A005823.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Jeffrey Shallit_

A005835.name: Pseudoperfect (or semiperfect) numbers k: some subset of the proper divisors of k sums to k.

A005836.name: Numbers whose base-3 representation contains no 2.
A005836.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Jeffrey Shallit_

A005846.name: Primes of the form k^2 + k + 41.
A005846.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005891.name: Centered pentagonal numbers: (5n^2+5n+2)/2; crystal ball sequence for 3.3.3.4.4. planar net.
A005891.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005899.name: Number of points on surface of octahedron; also coordination sequence for cubic lattice: a(0) = 1; for n > 0, a(n) = 4n^2 + 2.
A005899.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A005902.name: Centered icosahedral (or cuboctahedral) numbers, also crystal ball sequence for f.c.c. lattice.

A005928.name: G.f.: s(1)^3/s(3), where s(k) = eta(q^k) and eta(q) is Dedekind's function, cf. A010815.

A006037.name: Weird numbers: abundant (A005101) but not pseudoperfect (A005835).
A006037.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A006046.name: Total number of odd entries in first n rows of Pascal's triangle: a(0) = 0, a(1) = 1, a(2k) = 3*a(k), a(2k+1) = 2*a(k) + a(k+1).  a(n) = Sum_{i=0..n-1} 2^wt(i).

A006368.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_ and _J. H. Conway_

A006369.name: a(n) = 2*n/3 for n divisible by 3, otherwise a(n) = round(4*n/3). Or, equivalently, a(3*n-2) = 4*n-3, a(3*n-1) = 4*n-1, a(3*n) = 2*n.

A006577.name: Number of halving and tripling steps to reach 1 in '3x+1' problem, or -1 if 1 is never reached.

A006666.name: Number of halving steps to reach 1 in '3x+1' problem, or -1 if this never happens.
A006666.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Bill Gosper_

A006667.name: Number of tripling steps to reach 1 from n in '3x+1' problem, or -1 if 1 is never reached.

A006842.name: Triangle read by rows: row n gives numerators of Farey series of order n.

A006843.name: Triangle read by rows: row n gives denominators of Farey series of order n.
A006843.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_

A006891.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Colin Mallows_, _Jeffrey Shallit_

A006960.name: Reverse and Add! sequence starting with 196.

A007088.name: The binary numbers (or binary words, or binary vectors, or binary expansion of n): numbers written in base 2.

A007089.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Robert G. Wilson v_

A007090.author: _N. J. A. Sloane_, _Robert G. Wilson v_
